description:
Affected extension: git-checkpoint.ex
Upstream: ctx.sessionManager.getLeafEntry() returns the current leaf entry (the latest node in the session tree). Used by git-checkpoint.ts to key stash checkpoints by the stable entry ID rather than a monotonic counter, enabling correct restore on /fork which references entry IDs.
Current workaround: checkpoints are keyed by a monotonic turn counter (map_size + 1). This breaks /fork restore because fork events carry an entry_id that can't be matched to the counter.
What's needed: Context must expose the current leaf entry ID (or the leaf entry struct) when dispatching events like turn_start and session_before_fork.
Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/examples/extensions/git-checkpoint.ts (ctx.sessionManager.getLeafEntry())
title: ctx.sessionManager.getLeafEntry() — expose current leaf entry ID to Context
